notes:
Wrong install type. GAMbit guessed from its folder that it was installed “for everyone”. The quiet installer then needed admin rights, couldn’t ask for them, and quit. GAMbit now checks how Windows has it registered, so a “just for me” install stays “just for me”.
The installer was closing itself. Before installing, it closes every running copy of GAMbit, and the command it used also closed anything GAMbit had started. That included the installer. It now closes only GAMbit.

What changed when you click Install now:

A message tells you GAMbit will close and reopen by itself in about a minute.
The installer writes a log to %TEMP%\GAMbit-update.log.
If an update ever doesn’t finish, GAMbit tells you the next time you open it. It offers Run the installer with the installer’s own window, so you can see any message it shows.
